title: Valorization of cocoa (Theobroma cacao L.) pod husks as a fruit pulp substitute in mango jam formulations: effects on jam qualities during storage and sensory discrimination
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4FB00331D, Paper
Open Access

Vinh-Lam Nguyen, Minh-Thoai Tran, Thuy-Diem Nguyen-Thi, Minh-Anh Nguyen, Minh-Tri Le, Tra-My Nguyen, Quoc-Duy Nguyen
In this study, fruit pulp from cocoa pod husks was utilized as a substitute in mango jam at two different ratios of 25% and 50% with and without the addition of commercial pectin in comparison with normal jam made from 100% mango pulp as control.
